{{Quote|Sergeant 126, deploy the stealth units now.''"<br />"''Roger roger&mdash;stealth units&mdash;activated.|Asajj Ventress and 126|<ref name="TCWCG" />}}
'''126''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and participated in the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Serving under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] during the battle, 126 was responsible for activating Confederate stealth units during an assault on a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-occupied [[agrocite processing facility]]. Although the Confederate attack succeeded, the facility, along with the entire [[Khorm/Legends|planet]], soon fell back into Republic hands.

==Biography==
126 was a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]]<ref name="ISotR1" /> manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]]<ref name="TCWCG" /> who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="ISotR1" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Battle of Khorm date">{{TCWdates|201}} Furthermore, since ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic]]'' takes place shortly before "Holocron Heist," it too can be dated to 22 BBY.</ref> the Confederacy engaged the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in a [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|battle]] for the valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]].<ref name="ISotR1" />

126 participated in the battle, serving under Confederate [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. After the Republic captured a Confederate [[agrocite processing facility]], Ventress planned an attack to retake it. However, before proceeding with the attack, Ventress hid a number of [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] in the [[Water/Legends|snow]] near the site of the upcoming battle.<ref name="ISotR1" />

126 was placed in charge of those stealth units and was to activate them on Ventress's command. Before long, the battle for the facility erupted. In the midst of the fight, Ventress ordered 126 to reveal the hidden [[Spider/Legends|spider]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. 126 complied and carried out the order, and the sudden appearance of the stealth units caught the Republic forces completely off-guard, allowing the Confederacy to recapture the agrocite processing plant.<ref name="ISotR1" /> However, the plant, along with the rest of Khorm, was soon lost for the Confederacy when the Republic won the battle.<ref name="ISotR3">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>

==Characteristics==
A part of the BX-series droid [[Commando/Legends|commando]] line,<ref name="ISotR1" /> 126 stood 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and weighed 85 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="Characteristics" /> The droid had [[Color/Legends|beige]]-colored plating and white [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="ISotR1" />

==Behind the scenes==
126 appeared in the [[The Clone Wars 7|seventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="ISotR1" /> on [[July 15]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-238/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-7|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #7}}</ref>
